summary: Regional HR Manager with roughly 5-6 years of progressive human resources experience in the banking sector, spanning full-cycle recruitment, employee relations, and performance management. Has led regional HR operations covering multiple states and managed a small HR team while partnering closely with business heads on hiring gaps, employee escalations, and performance issues. Background includes rapid large-scale hiring (250 hires in four months for a new banking vertical), HRIS and payroll onboarding coordination, investigation and disciplinary reporting, and recruitment forecasting and attrition analysis, with some process improvements adopted into policy. Holds an MBA in Human Resources.
